ActionDescriptions.HelpAgentPromptAction:
Base action type for approved Buffaly Help Agent guided walkthrough prompt workflows. Execute returns private walkthrough guidance that the Help Agent must follow interactively; it is not a user-visible answer or display result.
ResponseResultType: status.
ResponseDirectiveContract: mirror tool envelope fields exactly into assistant message metadata (format/result_type) and content text.

ActionDescriptions.ToCreateInMemoryDataFilteringWalkthrough:
walk me through creating an in-memory data filtering ProtoScript action
Guide the user through the approved In-Memory Data Filtering ProtoScript walkthrough, teaching DataTable references, native filtering, low token usage, and LLM bypass for large data.

ActionDescriptions.ToSearchWebWithLlmForHelp:
to search the web with an LLM for Help Agent
question - narrow external public question to research using native live web search. Uses the current Buffaly runtime model selection and account-backed transport. Fails if native search is unavailable; never falls back to an API key, another model/provider, or an ordinary answer without search. Callers cannot choose or override the model.
